title: The tutor: a student fitted and measured for every point with enough confirmed labels, kept whole in every version, in shadow, never promoted
request: A students' agent that refits and measures students on the store's sets, keeps every version, never promotes.
plan: Fit with table-grouped folds, measure on confirmed dev labels beside the rule.
Keep the model, card, snapshot, measurement and its shadow entry.

decisions.decision: Train on confirmed labels when there are enough; silver only otherwise, said.
decisions.why: The fitting does not weigh rows; mixing silver in as confirmed would teach the teacher's errors at full weight.

change: dclab_rnd.store.tutor (teach), the harness agent tutor, the conductor's tutor step.

findings.defect: The tutor's folds used the wrong group.
findings.scenario: A table without a project was its own group per row.
findings.cause: The group was rebuilt from provenance.
findings.fix: Each example carries its split group (DecisionExample v2).

findings.defect: Silver labels were trained and measured as confirmed.
findings.scenario: Teacher labels in the dev accuracy.
findings.fix: Confirmed first, measured on confirmed only.

findings.defect: A student abstained on unseen groups.
findings.scenario: The test's label followed its project exactly.
findings.fix: A label independent of the group.

outcome: Every point with enough confirmed labels gets a measured student kept whole and listed in shadow, never promoted.
lessons: Make the group the example's own field: rebuilding it later loses tables.
risks: No workspace yet reads the store's shadow list.
